summary_en: This study tests AZD0516 alone and in combination with AZD9574 in participants with metastatic prostate cancer. AZD0516 is given by intravenous infusion, and AZD9574 is given by mouth; how long or how often is not stated. The main outcome is safety and tolerability, and the study is Phase 1/Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa AZD0516 solo y en combinación con AZD9574 en participantes con cáncer de próstata metastásico. AZD0516 se administra por infusión intravenosa y AZD9574 por vía oral; la duración o la frecuencia no están indicadas. El resultado principal es la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y el estudio es de Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Confirmed metastatic prostate adenocarcinoma, with focal high-grade neuroendocrine features allowed.
Measurable PSA of at least 1 ng/mL at screening.
Surgically or medically castrated, with testosterone at or below 50 ng/dL, or ongoing hormone therapy.
Documented progression of metastatic castration-resistant disease at screening.
not_for: Spinal cord compression, symptomatic brain metastases, or leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.
Unresolved grade 2 or higher side effects from prior therapy.
Uncontrolled intercurrent illness in the last 12 months, or significant cardiovascular disorders.
History of non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or active tuberculosis, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV.
Prior STEAP2-targeting treatment or topoisomerase-inhibiting chemotherapy, or MDS/AML.
